AUTHOR: Kitchingman
TITLE: Fish use of restored mangroves matches that in natural mangroves regardless of forest age
REGION: Moreton Bay, southeast Queensland, Australia (restored and natural mangroves)
SPECIES: yellowfin bream, sea mullet, common toadfish, common silverbiddy (targets) + 5 less common species (sand whiting, crescent grunter, etc.)
DATA: Own unbaited remote underwater video (SJCAM action cameras), 280 h; 255 training snippets (13,928 annotations)
V_EV: Methods: training snippets 'contained the target species from various angles at different turbidity levels'; 'Depth at the fringe cameras was 0.8 m at the top of the tide'
D2: 80/20 train/validation; separate test set of 76 videos from 1 of 5 cameras per site-zone excluded from training
D_EV: Methods: 'test dataset that contained 4,112 fish annotations from 76 videos of 1 of the 5 cameras (per site-zone combination) that was excluded from the training'
R_EV: Methods: test videos from held-out cameras within the same Moreton Bay survey (same campaign; P2)
C_EV: Methods: 'species-specific confidence threshold of 95, 90, 70, and 60% ... chosen to maximize accuracy'; 'sequential nonmaximum suppression to minimize false detections'
E_EV: Methods: 'We determined the performance of the DL model using the F1 score on abundance estimates ... which in our case was MaxN'; overall F1 79%
ARCH: Object detection DL model (architecture not named in text) with transfer learning from Ditria et al. 2021 model; Seq-NMS post-processing
METR: F1 on MaxN; mean MaxN per 20-min, ANOVA, Spearman
NOTE: Unbaited RUVs (short tidal deployments) coded as fixed camera; could be coded BRUV (RUV). Held-out-camera test within same campaign -> D=Y, R=N (P2). Seq-NMS counted as stated duplicate/false-detection handling mechanism for C5 (example given in instructions). Architecture not stated in main text (likely Mask R-CNN per prior Ditria work, not verified). PRE coded 수중 데이터셋 based on transfer from previously trained underwater fish model.
